newsitem.title: GERMANY: Gardena shares price range 34-38 dmk - Dresdner.
newsitem.headline: Gardena shares price range 34-38 dmk - Dresdner.

text.p: The bookbuilding price range for new shares in German garden equipment maker Gardena Holding AG has been set at 34 to 38 marks, lead manager Dresdner Bank AG said on Tuesday.
The bookbuilding period runs from September 18 through September 24 and shares are expected to be listed in Frankfurt and Stuttgart on September 27.

Gardena, based in Munich, is offering 1.14 million preferred shares at five marks par value following a capital increase of seven million marks which brought its equity capital up to 57 million marks.
